Exercise nine. Money. Some places are richer than others, and this is not one of them. Damaged and dirty houses are a sure sign of poverty; so are poor roads and few shops. You have been given the wealth map, with the roads, buildings and shops. Look at the houses around you, judge how badly off this place is, and guess somewhere just as poor. You are reminded that your own salary is not much better.
